title: The Coronal Ejection Refuge
logline: An unpreventable coronal mass ejection bears down on an unshielded mining belt, leaving an emergency bunker with scrubbers enough for only one crew: the injured drillers or the reactor technicians needed to restart the station.

roles.description: Triage doctor at the belt drilling camp; exhausted, fiercely protective of her burn patients.
Chief turbine technician; pragmatic, terrified, arguing that the habitat dies if the reactor scrams cold.
The extraction firm operating both the deep quarries and the power station.
A lead-lined subterranean survival vault dug into the dense asteroid core.
A thin-walled pressurized clinic pod exposed on the quarry surface.

public_situation: Flare warning sirens echo across {system} as solar observatories confirm a massive coronal mass ejection will strike the asteroid belt within hours.
private_truth: The air scrubber filters in {role:deep_bunker} have degraded, leaving sufficient life-support volume for only one shift before carbon dioxide toxicity sets in.

beats.public_change: High-energy proton counts spike across outer sensors as drilling crews scramble for evacuation locks.

missions.reason: Courier portable dialysis filters and burn medication from the surface clinic to the deep bunker before radiation breaches the pod.
missions.private_fact: Three of her patients are too unstable to walk and will require constant life-support power inside the shelter.

beats.public_change: Auroral curtains engulf the belt as the reactor station begins an emergency descent into standby mode.

missions.reason: Mine and haul dense ferrite ore to pack the bunker air intake conduits against incoming ionized solar plasma.
missions.private_fact: If his engineering team does not maintain the manual coolant loop during the storm, the reactor core will freeze solid and never restart.

beats.public_change: The radiation front is forty minutes out as both crews assemble outside the bunker airlock demanding entry.

missions.reason: Scan the bunker scrubber manifold to confirm whether an auxiliary recycling loop can be jury-rigged in time.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate slashed maintenance budgets on replacement scrubber canisters six months ago.

player_choice.prompt: The radiation storm arrives in twenty minutes. The bunker cannot sustain both crews under normal operation. The pilot holds the hatch override.

options.label: Seal the bunker for the medic and her injured drillers, accepting that the uncrewed reactor will freeze
Admit the reactor technicians to protect the habitat power grid, leaving the drillers in surface pods
Force both crews inside on half-rations while rigging the dangerous uncertified auxiliary scrubber

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot admits the injured drillers into the bunker.
resolutions.summary: {role:quarry_medic} and her patients survive the coronal storm. The uncrewed reactor freezes permanently, abandoning the station to a cold winter.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot held the airlock against corporate engineers to ensure wounded belt drillers survived a lethal solar flare.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot admits the reactor technicians to secure the station grid.
resolutions.summary: {role:reactor_engineer} restarts the reactor grid after the storm. The unprotected surface drillers perish, securing power at a terrible human cost.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces both crews inside on emergency oxygen rationing.
resolutions.summary: Both crews survive with acute lung scarring from the smoking auxiliary scrubbers. The reactor is saved and the drillers live, bound by shared trauma.

resolutions.reached_by: The bunker airlock is breached in panic or the pilot never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: Crowds storm {role:deep_bunker} without rationing controls. The scrubbers choke on carbon dioxide, suffocating everyone inside as the storm passes.

loose_threads.detail: A supply voucher for twelve medical-grade CO2 scrubber cartridges was denied three weeks ago citing logistics costs.
Spot prices for unrefined ferrite jumped twenty percent twelve hours before the solar storm alert was broadcast.
The encrypted keycard registry for {role:deep_bunker} lists four executive priority slots with names that match nobody on station.

radio_hooks: Heliophysics monitors detect major coronal mass ejection heading toward outer mining belt.
Asteroid drilling operations ordered to initiate emergency radiation sheltering protocols.
Station maintenance reports widespread electrical grid fluctuations ahead of coronal shockwave.

voice_direction.quarry_medic: Hoarse, fierce, and defiant. Uses plain diagnostic terms and refuses to debate economic priorities while people are bleeding.
voice_direction.reactor_engineer: Controlled, desperate, and technical. Speaks in rapid operational checklists, trying to mask his panic behind infrastructure calculations.
